advancements.ultimatetweaks.eresunviciad: You got the Galactic Star. You have too much free time.
Welcome to Ultimate Tweaks. It's too late to turn back now.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_allow: If not empty, the only commands players can use in the zone, one per line, without the slash.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_block: Whether players who are not members of the team can break blocks in the zone.
Whether players who are not members of the team can place blocks in the zone.
Whether farmland can be trampled in the zone.
Commands players cannot use in the zone, one per line, without the slash.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_breez: Whether the wind charges of a breeze burst in the zone.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_chest: Whether players who are not members of the team can open chests and other inventories in the zone.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_choru: Whether chorus fruit can teleport players into or inside the zone.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_creep: Whether creeper explosions damage blocks and entities in the zone.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_crop_: Whether crops and saplings can grow in the zone.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_damag: Whether players who are not members of the team can hurt animals in the zone.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_deny_: Message shown to a player when an action is denied in the zone. Empty for none.
Entity types that can never spawn in the zone, one per line (minecraft:zombie).
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_ender: Whether the ender dragon destroys blocks in the zone.
Whether endermen pick up and place blocks in the zone.
Whether ender pearls can be used to teleport into or inside the zone.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_entit: Whether anything that is not a player can destroy item frames in the zone.
Whether anything that is not a player can destroy paintings in the zone.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_entry: If off, players who are not members of the team cannot enter the zone.
Message shown when entering is denied.
If off, players who are not members of the team cannot leave the zone.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_exit_: Message shown when leaving is denied.
If exit is denied, whether players can still leave by teleporting.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_exp_d: Whether killed mobs drop experience in the zone.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_fall_: Whether players take fall damage in the zone.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_farew: Chat message shown on leaving. Use & for colors, {team} for the team name and {owner} for the owner name. Empty for none.
Title shown on leaving; a subtitle can follow after \n. Empty for none.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_feed_: Food points restored each time (removed if negative).
Seconds between feedings in the zone. 0 disables feeding.
Highest food level that feeding can bring players to.
Lowest food level that a negative feed amount can bring players to.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_firew: Whether fireworks can hurt players in the zone.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_game_: Game mode (survival, creative, adventure, spectator) applied to players while they are in the zone. Empty for none.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_ghast: Whether ghast fireballs and wither skulls damage blocks and entities in the zone.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_greet: Chat message shown on entering. Use & for colors, {team} for the team name and {owner} for the owner name. Empty for none.
Title shown on entering; a subtitle can follow after \n. Empty for none.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_heal_: Half hearts healed each time (damage if negative).
Seconds between heals in the zone. 0 disables healing.
Highest health that healing can bring players to.
Lowest health that a negative heal amount can bring players to.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_inter: Whether players who are not members of the team can interact with blocks and entities in the zone (not inventories).
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_invin: If on, players take no damage in the zone.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_item_: Whether players can drop items in the zone.
Whether items in item frames can be rotated in the zone.
Whether players can pick up items in the zone.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_lava_: Whether lava turns into stone, cobblestone or obsidian when it meets water in the zone.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_light: Whether flint and steel and fire charges can be used in the zone.
If off, lightning in the zone is only visual: no fire and no damage.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_mob_d: Whether mobs can hurt players in the zone.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_mob_s: Whether mobs can spawn in the zone. The spawn types it blocks are set in the common config.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_natur: If off, players do not regain health from food in the zone.
If off, players do not lose hunger in the zone.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_other: Whether any other explosion damages blocks and entities in the zone.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_pisto: Whether pistons in the zone can move.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_potio: Whether splash and lingering potions take effect in the zone.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_pvp.t: Whether players can hurt each other in the zone.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_ravag: Whether ravagers destroy blocks in the zone.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_respa: Whether respawn anchors can be used in the zone.
Whether players can mount vehicles and animals in the zone.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_send_: Whether players can send chat messages from the zone.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_sleep: Whether players can sleep in beds in the zone.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_snowm: Whether snow golems leave snow behind them in the zone.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_spawn: Where players respawn after dying in the zone, as three numbers: x y z. Empty for the normal respawn.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_time_: Time of day players see while in the zone, in ticks (0 to 24000), or day, noon, night, midnight. Empty for none.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_tnt.t: Whether TNT damages blocks and entities in the zone.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_use.t: Whether doors, trapdoors, fence gates, buttons and levers can be used in the zone.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_use_a: Whether anvils can be used in the zone.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_vehic: Whether players who are not members of the team can destroy boats and minecarts in the zone.
Whether boats and minecarts can be placed in the zone.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_weath: Weather players see while in the zone: clear or rain. Empty for none.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_wind_: Whether wind charges burst in the zone.
ftbteamsconfig.ultimatetweaks.flag_withe: Whether the wither's own explosions damage blocks and entities in the zone.
view.ultimatetweaks.transformation.burni: Drop it into fire or lava
view.ultimatetweaks.transformation.consu: %s%% chance to use up the fluid
view.ultimatetweaks.transformation.fluid: Drop the catalysts into the fluid
